Requested from Android only after you choose to use this feature. You may decline; the related feature may be unavailable. Master-password login remains available.
Enable or manage this access in system settings when needed. If disabled, the related service or optional feature is unavailable; master-password login remains available.
Declared for Android to grant automatically. No runtime prompt or individual permission switch. It is used when you enable the related feature.
This declaration restricts who can send internal broadcasts or bind to services. It does not authorize Monica to access your data and cannot be requested from you.
This shows hardware and enrollment availability, not permission approval or Monica’s unlock setting. Enrollment is managed in system settings; master-password login remains available.
Scan QR codes and take photos. Gallery selection does not need camera access.
Android 8–9 needs storage permission to save generated images. These older systems also add read access to the write permission. Selecting photos always uses the selected file’s URI grant.

Fill an address from your current location when you ask. Precise location is also required for temporary hotspots on Android 12 and earlier. Approximate location can be used for addresses; no background location is requested.
Nearby Wi-Fi devices
Create or join a temporary sync hotspot on Android 13 and later. Existing Wi-Fi sync remains available if declined. This permission is not used to derive location.
NFC cards and security keys

Read publicly accessible details from supported contactless bank cards and connect NFC FIDO security keys for Passkeys. Requires an NFC-capable device with NFC enabled. Passwords, OTP and Wi-Fi sync do not depend on NFC.
Optional biometric authentication; Android 8 uses the legacy fingerprint declaration.
Cloud backup, account services, remote databases and local-network sync. Network access alone does not start a transfer.
Check connectivity so network features can react to connection changes.
Read Wi-Fi state or manage user-requested local sync connections and temporary hotspots.
Discover nearby sync peers through local-network multicast.
Optional touch feedback, including Monica keyboard keys. Respects system haptic settings.
Show OTP, sync, export and background-service notifications. Before Android 13, notification access is managed in system settings.
Optional promoted ongoing notifications on Android 16. Standard notifications remain available if promotion is disabled.
Display over other apps
Optional HyperOS save compatibility panel. It contains no credentials and is used only when you enable that compatibility feature.
Install app updates
Open downloaded Monica APK updates in the system installer. Every installation still requires system confirmation.
Optional exemption for continuous OTP notifications and service protection. Android may pause background work without it.
Android autofill for apps and browsers. The binding permission protects this service; the user enables it in system settings.
Optional manual fill from the quick-settings tile and picker. The service remains subject to Monica authentication.
Optional Monica input method for filling credentials. Enabled keyboard status is separate from which keyboard is currently selected.
Credential provider
Provide passwords and Passkeys through Android 14 and later system credential flows. Other providers are not changed.
Shizuku access
Optional Shizuku access for default-service management and accessibility recovery. Authorization is managed in Shizuku; no access is requested at startup.
Keep user-started sync, export, OTP notifications or optional service protection running with a foreground notification.
Reschedule enabled background work after a restart, following your existing settings.
WorkManager keeps scheduled work running briefly while it executes. It does not enable continuous background activity by itself.
Block other apps’ overlays during credential export on Android 12 and later.
AndroidX protects internal dynamic receivers with an app-only signature permission.
Android restricts binding to this service to callers holding the declared system permission.
A permission declared by this installed package or a dependency. See the Android identifier below for its exact scope; no automatic request is made.
